settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Order today for next-day delivery in supported Dubai areas. Your available delivery date is confirmed during checkout.

settings.question: What is the order cut-off time?
settings.answer: Check the delivery information shown at checkout for the current cut-off. Orders received after the applicable cut-off move to the next available delivery day.

settings.question: Which areas of Dubai do you deliver to?
settings.answer: Choose your area in the header. Final service availability is confirmed using your full delivery address at checkout.

settings.question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
settings.answer: Cash on Delivery is available only when it is offered as a payment method at checkout. Otherwise, choose one of the secure online payment methods shown there.

settings.question: How much does delivery cost?
settings.answer: Delivery fees depend on your basket total. See the current tiers below; your final fee is confirmed at checkout.

settings.question: What if something is not right with my order?
settings.answer: Please contact our support team using the contact page with your order number and details. Our published returns policy explains eligibility and the next steps.

settings.question: Can I pay in instalments?
settings.answer: Eligible instalment options are offered only if an approved provider is available at checkout. Provider eligibility and terms apply.
